This month, Apple will unveil its first foldable iPhone, reportedly named the iPhone Ultra. The device is said to feature a 5.5-inch outer display and a 7.6-inch inner display. Samsung already launched its new-generation Galaxy Z Fold 8 back in July, using exactly the same screen sizes.

Whether Samsung deliberately released the phone ahead of the iPhone Ultra is another matter, but in any case, the Galaxy Z Fold 8 has given us an initial idea of what the actual user experience of the iPhone Ultra will be like.

Reviewers who got early hands-on time with the Galaxy Z Fold 8 have recently been posting comparison photos on Twitter. Since the iPhone Ultra is similar in size to the Galaxy Z Fold 8, these comparisons let us preview how the iPhone Ultra will look and feel in real-world scenarios.

Ray Wong posted several comparison photos of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 alongside the previous-generation iPad mini, highlighting that the phone can indeed fit an iPad mini-sized screen in your pocket, and with even narrower bezels.

Meanwhile, enthusiast Shishir shared comparison photos of the iPhone 13 mini and the Galaxy Z Fold 8. The iPhone 13 mini is slightly taller than this foldable device, but both are equally compact. For users who love the iPhone mini series, the iPhone Ultra may well bring back that familiar feeling.

Personally, after getting hands-on time with the Galaxy Z Fold 8 last week, I'm actually even more excited about the iPhone Ultra. The two are almost identical in size (although the iPhone Ultra is reportedly going with rounded corners) — so before its official debut in September, this is the best preview we have of what Apple has up its sleeve.

Of course, you can also refer to photos of dummy units for further comparison.
